title: COMPLETE D14 nonempty non-JSON-container predicate
purpose: COMPLETE for the declared D14/T19 source predicates: nonempty assistant text and not a JSON container. Semantic refusal and Vessel-orchestration redirection are outside this predicate; unrelated nonempty prose passes. The user-defined lexical refusal rubric is a separate case. Not semantic success or runtime compatibility.

inputs.intent: Return only JSON with title, summary, records, series, and actions. Use at least one record and one action. Keep series points sorted by x when present.
